execution_note: The first process was paused to enforce five idle seconds after responses, then resumed with successful checkpoints reused. The final live run stopped after three consecutive daily jobs exhausted all configured retries.
notes: Pipeline log counts exclude the initial single-request preflight HTTP 429, which was recorded separately.
Interrupted requests may have an unknown outcome; no unlogged request or HTTP status is inferred.
Retry announcements count scheduled retries and may include a retry announced immediately before interruption that never started.
HTTP statuses count only client INFO response lines. Transport failures count only client WARNING attempt lines, excluding their duplicate retry-warning descriptions.
Durable checkpoint counters finalize logical-window attempts; interruption can leave observed execution events absent from those counters.
Checkpoint counters sum all current checkpoint files. They are not inferred from logs and may span active query/configuration identities.
Log and checkpoint snapshots are read sequentially while collection may continue; rerun after the process stops for final reconciliation.
Log timestamps have no recorded timezone and are preserved as written; generated_at_utc is an explicit UTC audit timestamp.
Observed article totals sum successful response counts, including retries/forced runs/parent windows if present; they are not deduplicated study article counts.
